facts.fact: Burundi Eco reports interior ministry officials announced in July 2024 the ID for D project to digitise civil status, in which from birth fingerprints and names are recorded electronically and each person gets a lifelong unique ID number.
facts.system: ID for D (Identite pour le Developpement)

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Community Development and Public Security
systems.tiers: funded under PAFEN (World Bank, USD 92 million)
